title: Orchestration Patterns
motto: Four orchestration patterns recur across 2026 frameworks: supervisor-worker, swarm / peer-to-peer, hierarchical, debate. Anthropic's guidance: "It's about building the right system for your needs." Start simple; add topology only when a single agent plus five workflow patterns is insufficient.

cards: Teams reach for "multi-agent" before they need it. Four patterns recur across frameworks; once you can name them, you can pick the right one — or skip topology entirely.
